tagline: Named for an island it never reaches.
intro: Hilton Head Island is not on this road. The Hilton Head Scenic Highway is eight miles of four-lane US 278 from I-95 near Hardeeville east to SC 170 at the Beaufort County line, a busy road carrying traffic toward the resorts around Bluffton and on the island. Off-premises billboards are banned along all of it.
The state named it in 1988 as a connector between I-95 and US 278. The highway number itself was moved onto this route only in the late 1990s.

moments.title: Purrysburg
moments.text: On the Savannah River northwest of Hardeeville, Swiss Protestants from Neuchâtel and Geneva built a town of about 100 houses that disease and tangled land grants slowly emptied.

moments.title: Hardeeville
moments.text: Isaac Hardee's son opened a depot and store on the railroad here, and Hardee's Station grew into a town known for swamp logging on narrow-gauge track.
